# Joaquin Ramirez

> Personal portfolio of Joaquin Ramirez, machine learning engineer and data scientist. MSBA candidate at UCLA Anderson in Los Angeles. Case studies of production work: a GenAI copilot and agentic systems serving 1300+ organizations, a RAG pipeline, contract-allocation optimization, and real-time fraud detection.
